import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_transform', path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def grid_from_lines(h,w, lines):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for key,color,orientation,lo,hi in lines:
        for t in range(lo,hi+1):
            r,c = ((key,t) if orientation=='row' else
                   (t,key) if orientation=='col' else
                   (t,t+key) if orientation=='diff' else
                   (t,key-t))
            if 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
                g[r][c]=color
    return g
# Demo 1: horizontal bars
D1=grid_from_lines(26,26,[(r,col,'row',0,25) for r,col in [(3,5),(9,5),(13,7),(18,4),(19,3),(21,6),(22,8)]])
P1=[6,8,5,5,4,3,7]
E1=[[P1[r%7]]*26 for r in range(26)]
# Demo 2: down-right diagonal classes c-r
D2=grid_from_lines(24,24,[(-5,3,'diff',5,23),(6,5,'diff',0,15),(8,7,'diff',0,15),(22,9,'diff',0,1),(-16,5,'diff',16,23)])
P2=[3,5,9,7,5]
E2=[[P2[(c-r)%5] for c in range(24)] for r in range(24)]
# Demo 3: down-left diagonal classes r+c
D3=grid_from_lines(12,12,[(1,5,'sum',0,1),(3,7,'sum',0,3),(7,3,'sum',0,7),(14,4,'sum',3,11),(15,3,'sum',4,11)])
P3=[3,5,3,7,4]
E3=[[P3[(r+c)%5] for c in range(12)] for r in range(12)]
for i,(d,e) in enumerate([(D1,E1),(D2,E2),(D3,E3)],1):
    got=mod.transform(d)
    print('demo',i,'match',got==e,'top-row',got[0])
